verdict.rationale: Bolt.new runs in an isolated WebContainer-style sandbox (full control over filesystem/node server without touching a live production system) per bolt-gh-2 and bolt-gh-1, and its Supabase integration lets you attach/create a database for development separate from deployment. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated staging vs. production data split or safeguards preventing accidental production data access. missing for 10: explicit staging/production environment separation, documented safeguards against touching live prod data, independent confirmation of sandbox isolation during testing.
